title: Structured Reasoning for Fairness: A Multi-Agent Approach to Bias Detection in Textual Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating statements from the WikiNPOV dataset using a multi-agent LLM pipeline that classifies text as factual or opinion-based, and then scores the presence of subjective/emotional language, strong value judgments, selective emphasis, and skewed framing to predict binary bias (biased vs. unbiased).
